descriptions.w3d_collision_state_is_contact: Returns whether the collision state lies between five and nine inclusive.
descriptions.w3d_motion_get_direction: Copies the stored direction to the output vector.
descriptions.w3d_motion_refresh_velocity: Refreshes velocity and doubles it when the observed speed flag is set.
descriptions.w3d_motion_set_actor_value: Sets a held actor field using a temporary handle.
descriptions.w3d_motion_has_combined_flags: Tests whether the sum of two interface integer values is nonzero.
descriptions.w3d_motion_apply_velocity_constraint: Applies two configured constraints to the stored velocity and direction.
descriptions.w3d_motion_get_input_direction: Builds a direction from input and override flags and limits its length.
descriptions.w3d_motion_owner_matches: Tests whether the owner handle identifies the stored entity.
descriptions.w3d_motion_get_contact_point: Copies the global collision contact point to the output vector.
descriptions.w3d_motion_slope_allowed: Tests whether the vector slope is within the configured maximum.
